plugins.name: claude-seo-geo
plugins.description: 20 SEO + GEO skills (every page skill runs spec, audit, competitor benchmark and build): traffic drop diagnosis, full site audit with SEO and GEO scores, technical SEO, content for every page type (homepage and sales page, blog and blog templates, product, service, collection, comparison and alternatives, customer segment), a page-section audit that finds the blocks missing from a page and writes them, a rendering fix for sites built by AI generators like Lovable and Base44, internal linking, schema, link building, local SEO, social amplification, AI visibility and AI traffic tracking, plus an Obsidian company-knowledge layer that grounds every skill.
